document: Measured episode throughput on llm1 — for 8b budgeting (理 11433, demoted to an idle slice)
method: read off the chains' OWN slice timestamps from today's runs. NOT a synthetic probe: these are the real arms at real budgets, which is the quantity 8b needs.
for_8b: a 300-episode arm costs 0.8-1.5 h on llm1 at budget 12. An 8b generation with a base + a fit + a wired arm is therefore ~2-4 h of GPU, not a day — the loop's cost is dominated by the NUMBER of generations, not by any single arm.
bounds: Wall-clock on llm1 with nothing else on the GPU. A contended box is slower and today's llm2 work did not touch llm1.
Budget drives it: R5-C's 14-24 budgets are slower per episode than budget 12.
SQL episodes are cheaper than v3's (4.3k vs 6.9k tokens/episode), so R7's 372/h is not the rate to budget a v3-shaped 8b arm with — use R6's 203/h.
